A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the agricultural sector is not an obstacle to economic growth but rather is an engine for economic growth.
the agricultural sector is not a drag on the overall growth of an economy, and in fact, it is an important source of growth.
we have found that the rate of growth of the agricultural and non-agricultural sectors are closely interrelated.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the agricultural sector has been growing faster than the economy in the post-independence era.
agricultural growth is a necessary but not sufficient condition for economic growth, and that the latter depends on a host of other factors.

there is a strong link between agricultural growth and economic growth, which is not only important for understanding economic growth in general but also for designing policies for economic growth in particular.
